questions.question: Find the area of a wall 4,5 m by 2,7 m with a door 0,9 m by 2,1 m, and how much paint two coats need if 1 l covers 8 m².
questions.expected_answer: 12,15 − 1,89 = 10,26 m². Two coats: 20,52 m² ÷ 8 ≈ 2,6 l, so buy at least 3 litres.

questions.question: Find the area of the L-shaped floor in two ways.
With 20 m of fencing, compare the areas of a 5 × 5 and a 9 × 1 pen. What does this show?
questions.expected_answer: 25 m² and 9 m². Shapes with the same perimeter can have very different areas; the square gives the largest.
